evaluation_protocol.area_definition: COCO default original-image bbox area ranges, IoU 0.50:0.95
notes: COCO area evaluation on converted VisDrone labels, not official VisDrone ignore regions.
Ultralytics AP and COCO AP_all are separate evaluators/prediction passes; do not mix them.
Batch val may use rectangular padding; area predict uses each 4-image chunk padding.
P/R are Ultralytics selected F1 operating point metrics, not P/R at conf=0.001.
Training built-in validation may use FP16 and double batch; final report is standalone FP32.

preflight_transfer.source: deterministic E1 initialized from original 80-class yolo11s.pt; never an experimental best.pt

source_audit.note: P2 fusion and P2 Detect are random; 10-class output layers are reinitialized.

preflight_transfer.note: Only TERP alignment, gate and alpha tensors are new; E1 backbone/neck/P2/Detect towers are exact.

p2_architecture.variant: E1 plus non-recursive task-exclusive reverse-pyramid residual routing inside Detect input preparation
p2_architecture.shared_base: P2/P3/P4/P5 remain shared by cv2 and cv3
p2_architecture.classification_sources: raw adjacent P3->P2, P4->P3, P5->P4; no recursive semantic cascade
p2_architecture.regression_alignment: trainable raw depthwise stride-2 conv with exact binomial initialization, then linear 1x1+BN
p2_architecture.residual_gain: 0.2*tanh(alpha), alpha initialized exactly zero per route
p2_architecture.claim_boundary: Only added cross-scale residual sources are task exclusive; base pyramid features are still shared
p2_architecture.unchanged: E1 neck, cv2/cv3 towers, reg_max=16, DFL/decode, TAL2, CIoU/DFL/BCE, NMS and training protocol
p2_architecture.no_modules: No DSSG, TSDR, FusionReady, RSG, SDQC, slicing, distillation, DySample, PGALP or loss change

tal2.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

implementation.note: Only matching chunk size changes from 1 to 2.

matching_equivalence.limits: Synthetic FP32-GT cases and batch8 real-model 128px steps; not a 1024px memory test or a guarantee of identical final AP.

smoke_gate.note: Two full training epochs + builtin validation + full FP32/area evaluation. Not an accuracy result.

training.memory_note: PyTorch allocator peaks, including in-training validation; not whole-device usage.
training.comparison_note: Full forward batch unchanged; image-wise matching only. Training time/memory comparisons require the same matching implementation on both models.

pretrained_transfer.source: deterministic E1 initialized from original 80-class yolo11s.pt; never an experimental best.pt

source_audit.note: P2 fusion and P2 Detect are random; 10-class output layers are reinitialized.

pretrained_transfer.note: Only TERP alignment, gate and alpha tensors are new; E1 backbone/neck/P2/Detect towers are exact.

validation.speed_note: Batched FP32 validation, NOT batch=1 deployment FPS.
